description:
[Merchant] Process a PEER transaction (for merchants accepting payments by scanning customer QR/barcode).

**Use Case:** Merchant scans customer's payware QR code or barcode to accept payment.
**Note:** Only PEER transactions (created by customers) can be processed by merchants.
**Flow:** Customer creates transaction → Merchant scans QR/barcode → Merchant processes transaction

**API Request Structure:**
```json
{
  "shop": "...",
  "account": "...", 
  "friendlyName": "...",
  "callbackUrl": "...",
  "passbackParams": "...",
  "trData": {
    "amount": "25.50",    // REQUIRED for processing
    "currency": "EUR",    // REQUIRED for processing
    "reasonL1": "...",    // REQUIRED for processing
    "reasonL2": "..."
  },
  "trOptions": {
    "timeToLive": 300     // Overwrites original transaction TTL
  }
}
```

account.description: Account identifier (optional - uses default if not provided)

amount.description: Amount as currency value to process (e.g., 25.50 for €25.50). Must be positive

callbackUrl.description: URL to receive transaction status callbacks

partnerId.description: Partner ID from payware dashboard. Can use PAYWARE_PARTNER_ID env var as default.

paymentMethod.description: Payment method chosen by customer. A2A = direct transfer (lower fee, no rewards). CARD_FUNDED = card-linked account (higher fee, rewards eligible). BNPL = buy now pay later (installments). INSTANT_CREDIT = credit line approved at purchase.

privateKey.description: RSA private key for JWT token creation. Can use PAYWARE_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH env var as default.

shop.description: Shop code (optional - uses default if not provided)

timeToLive.description: Time allowed for transaction processing in seconds

transactionId.description: Transaction ID to process. Format: 2-char prefix + 8-char ID. Supports: 'pw' (standard), 'pr' (product), 'ps' (soundbite)

name: payware_operations_process_transaction
